stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Desktop 2.7.4 hotfix fixes a Jobs.cz application-preparation crash caused by h1_text being referenced before initialization during browser company extraction. h1_text is now resolved before metadata/title parsing, so APPLY candidates can continue into company extraction and form preparation. A regression smoke test reproduces the metadata path that crashed in 2.7.3. The v2.7.3 scoring, Indeed CAPTCHA/reload-loop handling, discovery rules, manual final Submit safety and thresholds are unchanged.
